environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'data-plane'. The Kafka consumer pod runs with a standard ClusterIP service. Kafka topic 'http-requests' is writable by any authenticated Kafka client (ACL: ALLOW principal=User:* operation=WRITE topic=http-requests). The backend services (8081/8082) are Go net/http servers that use standard library request parsing. No ingress controller or ALB sits in front of the Kafka producer path. Network policy allows any pod in the cluster to produce to Kafka on port 9092.

config.backend_servers: Go net/http with default parsing (CL+TE ambiguity)
config.tls: plaintext kafka, no mTLS on any path
